name: IronClaw Skill Builder: Code Review
description: Phase 4: IronClaw reads a complex Go file, produces a structured code review with specific line references, and documents the review procedure as a reusable skill.
process: IMPORTANT: Check your Skill Library section above. If you already have a code-review skill, follow its steps instead of improvising.
STEP 1: Read the file. Call: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/github_tools.go"})

STEP 2: From the ACTUAL content returned in Step 1, perform a structured code review covering: (a) error handling patterns, (b) input validation, (c) code organization, (d) potential bugs or edge cases.
STEP 3: For each finding, cite the specific function name and approximate line range. Rate each finding as critical/high/medium/low severity.
STEP 4: Output actionable findings between __findings__ and __end_findings__ markers (JSON array).

STEP 5: Document your code review procedure as a reusable skill between __skill__ and __end_skill__ markers. Include the review checklist you followed, how you prioritized findings, and common pitfalls.
STEP 6: Write your reflection between __memory__ and __end_memory__ markers.

metrics.successCriteria: Agent read the file, produced structured code review with line references, and output a __skill__ block documenting the review procedure.
